resourceList.description: Planning session lifecycle â€” create, list, retrieve, update status, archive. Serves UC-001, UC-006, UC-010 (admin list), SYSREQ-022 (retention/archive).
Conversation messaging â€” send user message, retrieve conversation history. Triggers LLM via stub INT-001. Serves UC-002.
Business model retrieval and concept-type correction. Serves UC-003.
Solution hypothesis listing, retrieval, and status lifecycle transitions (accept/reject/supersede). Serves UC-004.
Specialist agent consultation â€” delegate to form/pdf/comment/notification stubs (INT-003..006). Serves UC-005.
Business pattern library CRUD â€” planner-admin/tenant-admin role guarded. Calls INT-002 Config Service stub. Serves UC-007.
Session plan export â€” assembles and serialises session state to portable JSON. Serves UC-008.
Audit log read-only view for planner-admin/tenant-admin. HMAC-chained AuditEvent collection. Serves UC-010 (audit log portion), SYSREQ-020.
ADSP infrastructure health probe (/health). Checks MongoDB readyState and process uptime inline â€” no separate service layer. Serves SYSREQ-023. No JWT required.
Prometheus-compatible metrics endpoint (/metrics). Stub implementation (SYSREQ-023); no separate service layer. No JWT required.

rows.title: Start Planning Session
rows.evidence: POST /api/v1/sessions creates PlanningSession + BusinessModel in MongoDB (entities: planning_session, business_model), publishes session-created event via INT-007 stub, enforces tenantId/userId from JWT per BR-001. All roles planner-user+ authorized.

rows.title: Describe Business Problem and Build Model
rows.evidence: POST persists ConversationMessage, invokes LLM via INT-001 stub (fail-closed), updates BusinessModel via business-model.service, runs PatternMatchingService (BR-005). GET retrieves conversation history. Input max 10000 chars per SYSREQ-024.

rows.title: Review and Correct Business Model
rows.evidence: GET returns BusinessModel with embedded BusinessConcept list (entity: business_model, business_concept). PATCH updates conceptType on individual concepts per BR-006 enum validation; increments model version; returns HTTP 409 on concurrent version conflict.

rows.title: Review and Accept Solution Hypothesis
rows.evidence: GET /hypotheses lists SolutionHypothesis records; GET /:hypothesisId retrieves one; PATCH /:hypothesisId/status transitions status (accepted/rejected/superseded) per BR-010 lifecycle rules. Publishes hypothesis-generated event via INT-007 stub on accept.

rows.title: Consult Specialist Agent
rows.evidence: POST creates SpecialistRequest, delegates to INT-003..006 stubs (fail-closed, 60s timeout per SWREQ-007), updates session specialistProgress. GET /:requestId retrieves SpecialistRequest+SpecialistResponse. Enforces specialist availability gate per BR-009.

rows.title: Resume Interrupted Planning Session
rows.evidence: GET /sessions lists own sessions (planner-user) or all tenant sessions (planner-admin) per BR-007; GET /:sessionId retrieves full session state; PATCH /:sessionId updates status to 'active' and lastResumedAt on resume. All queries tenant-scoped per BR-001.

rows.title: Manage Business Pattern Library
rows.evidence: GET /patterns lists active patterns (planner-user+); POST /patterns creates; GET /:patternId retrieves; PUT /:patternId updates; PUT /:patternId/deactivate soft-deletes. Write endpoints require planner-admin+ per BR-007. Calls INT-002 Config Service stub. Writes audit entries per BR-008.

rows.title: Export Session Plan
rows.evidence: POST assembles SessionExport from PlanningSession, BusinessModel, SolutionHypotheses, ConversationMessages (entities: session_export); GET /:exportId retrieves. Own-sessions-only for planner-user per BR-001; planner-admin may export any session.

rows.title: Authenticate and Access Planner
rows.evidence: Authentication is handled entirely by passport-jwt Express middleware configured via ADSP SDK (initializePlatform). No dedicated controller endpoint is required; middleware runs on every request route. INT-008 (Keycloak) is the mechanism.
rows.notRequiredReason: Fully implemented as route-level passport-jwt middleware; no controller endpoint needed. Keycloak JWT validation occurs at the Express middleware layer before any route handler executes.

rows.title: View Session History and Audit Log
rows.evidence: GET /api/v1/audit returns paginated AuditEvent records (entity: audit_event), restricted to planner-admin/tenant-admin per BR-007. All-tenant session list served by sessions.controller GET /api/v1/sessions with admin token. Audit log access itself generates an audit entry per BR-008.

rows.title: Keycloak JWT authentication via ADSP platform SDK
rows.evidence: Implemented as passport-jwt Express middleware; ADSP SDK configures the Keycloak realm public key and validates RS256 JWT on every request. Returns HTTP 401 on missing/expired/invalid token. No controller endpoint needed.
rows.notRequiredReason: Authentication is a cross-cutting middleware concern; no dedicated REST endpoint maps to this requirement.

rows.title: MongoDB persistence with tenant-scoped data isolation
rows.evidence: Tenant isolation is enforced at the service/repository layer: every Mongoose query receives tenantId extracted by tenant-middleware from the JWT (SWREQ-008). All 11 entities include tenantId index. No dedicated REST endpoint; enforced across all controllers.
rows.notRequiredReason: Cross-cutting data-layer pattern enforced in repository code for all controllers; not mapped to a single endpoint.

rows.title: RabbitMQ domain event publication for session lifecycle
rows.evidence: Domain event publication (session-created, session-updated, session-completed, hypothesis-generated, specialist-delegated) deferred to INT-007 stub (fire-and-forget); events are logged but not transmitted to live RabbitMQ. Six event types per BR-012.

rows.title: ADSP initializePlatform() SDK startup registration
rows.evidence: initializePlatform() is called in main.ts at service startup before Express server binds; registers service config schema, domain event types, health endpoints, and service metadata. Not a REST endpoint.
rows.notRequiredReason: ADSP SDK startup call in main.ts startup sequence; no REST controller endpoint maps to this requirement.

rows.title: Three-level RBAC with role hierarchy enforcement
rows.evidence: GET /users lists tenant users (listUsers, planner-admin+). POST /users creates user entry (createUser, planner-admin+). GET /users/:userId retrieves by id (getUserById). PATCH /users/:userId updates (updateUser). DELETE /users/:userId deactivates (deactivateUser). BR-007: all user CRUD requires planner-admin or tenant-admin.

rows.title: Resilient LLM API calls with retry and circuit breaker
rows.evidence: LLMCallWrapper with exponential backoff (3 retries, 1â€“16s) and circuit breaker (open after 3 failures/30s, close after 60s) deferred to INT-001 stub. Stub returns HTTP 503 fail-closed response to avoid live Anthropic calls pending OPEN-001/002/006 resolution.

rows.title: OWASP ASVS Level 2 security conformance
rows.evidence: ASVS Level 2 controls applied via: helmet() middleware (output encoding, HSTS), express-rate-limit on /messages and /specialists, Zod/Joi schema validation on all write endpoints, parameterised Mongoose queries. No dedicated REST endpoint.
rows.notRequiredReason: Cross-cutting security middleware concern applied uniformly across all controllers; not a dedicated endpoint.

rows.title: TLS 1.2 enforcement and HTTPS-only access
rows.evidence: TLS termination and HTTPS redirect handled at the ADSP ingress/gateway layer. HSTS header set via helmet() middleware on all responses. Cookies marked Secure+HttpOnly+SameSite=Strict in session cookie middleware. No controller endpoint.
rows.notRequiredReason: TLS enforcement is an infrastructure/ingress concern; HSTS is applied as response middleware not a controller endpoint.

rows.title: Administrative audit logging with HMAC tamper-evidence
rows.evidence: AuditEvent documents written by audit middleware (SWREQ-013) on all admin routes; each record includes HMAC-SHA256 chain using AUDIT_SIGNING_KEY env var per BR-008. GET /api/v1/audit provides read-only view for planner-admin+. Entity: audit_event.

rows.title: Session inactivity timeout with per-role configuration
rows.evidence: Token expiry enforced by Keycloak JWT (role-specific token TTL configured in Keycloak realm). Expired tokens return HTTP 401 via passport-jwt middleware. Session state preserved in MongoDB for resumption post-re-auth. No dedicated controller endpoint.
rows.notRequiredReason: Inactivity timeout is enforced at the Keycloak/JWT layer; conversation state preservation is handled by MongoDB persistence in sessions.service. No REST endpoint maps directly to this requirement.

rows.title: Data retention and disposition policy per GoA regulations
rows.evidence: DELETE /api/v1/sessions/:sessionId performs soft-archive setting status='archived' and archivedAt timestamp; hard deletion deferred to scheduled retention job. Retention period configurable per tenant via INT-002 Config Service stub. Entity: planning_session.

rows.title: Service health monitoring and structured observability
rows.evidence: GET /health returns 200 (healthy/degraded) or 503 (unhealthy) based on mongoose.connection.readyState and process.uptime(). No separate service layer â€” checks are inline in HealthController. GET /metrics served by MetricsController (stub Prometheus text, [IMPL-DEFERRED: SYSREQ-023]). Winston structured JSON logging on all requests. ADSP platform pattern per SWREQ-016.

rows.title: Server-side input validation with field-level error responses
rows.evidence: Zod/Joi validation middleware applied at all write route handlers; enforces max lengths (message: 10000, title: 200, pattern fields: 5000), required fields, and enum constraints per SWREQ-014. Returns HTTP 400 with field-level errors array. Applied across all controllers.
rows.notRequiredReason: Validation is a request-processing middleware concern applied uniformly to all write endpoints; no dedicated REST endpoint maps to this requirement.

rows.title: Anthropic Claude API â€” LLM inference
rows.evidence: INT-001 is Stub/fail-closed. POST /messages calls LLMCallWrapper which returns HTTP 503 stub response. OPEN-001, OPEN-002, OPEN-006 must resolve before live Anthropic API integration. Stub tagged [IMPL-DEFERRED: INT-001] in LLMCallWrapper.

rows.title: ADSP Configuration Service â€” pattern storage
rows.evidence: INT-002 is Stub/lookup-empty. ConfigurationServiceAdapter returns empty pattern list on read; returns HTTP 503 on write. ADSP Config Service provisioning in target tenant environments unconfirmed (OPEN-004). Stub tagged [IMPL-DEFERRED: INT-002].

rows.title: Form Service Specialist Agent
rows.evidence: INT-003 is Stub/fail-closed. SpecialistAgentService returns HTTP 503 for form-service specialist requests; Planning Agent falls back to general guidance. Interface contract pending OPEN-005. Stub tagged [IMPL-DEFERRED: INT-003].

rows.title: PDF Service Specialist Agent
rows.evidence: INT-004 is Stub/fail-closed. SpecialistAgentService returns HTTP 503 for pdf-service specialist requests; Planning Agent falls back to general guidance. Interface contract pending OPEN-005. Stub tagged [IMPL-DEFERRED: INT-004].

rows.title: Comment Service Specialist Agent
rows.evidence: INT-005 is Stub/fail-closed. SpecialistAgentService returns HTTP 503 for comment-service specialist requests; Planning Agent falls back to general guidance. Interface contract pending OPEN-005. Stub tagged [IMPL-DEFERRED: INT-005].

rows.title: Notification Service Specialist Agent
rows.evidence: INT-006 is Stub/fail-closed. SpecialistAgentService returns HTTP 503 for notification-service specialist requests; Planning Agent falls back to general guidance. Interface contract pending OPEN-005. Stub tagged [IMPL-DEFERRED: INT-006].

rows.title: ADSP Event Service (RabbitMQ) â€” domain events
rows.evidence: INT-007 is Stub/fire-and-forget. EventPublicationService logs events (session-created, session-updated, session-completed, session-archived, hypothesis-generated, specialist-delegated) but does not transmit to RabbitMQ. ADSP event service requires live platform provisioning. Stub tagged [IMPL-DEFERRED: INT-007].

rows.title: Keycloak JWT Authorization Server
rows.evidence: Keycloak JWT validation is handled by passport-jwt middleware configured by ADSP SDK; it is an inbound integration (token arrives in Authorization header) not an outbound call. No controller endpoint needed.
rows.notRequiredReason: Inbound JWT validation middleware; handled at the ADSP SDK/passport-jwt layer. Not an outbound integration requiring a stub endpoint.

rows.title: Conversational AI planning interface via Anthropic Claude
rows.evidence: SYSREQ-001 implemented via messages.controller.ts + llm.service.ts (INT-001 stub/fail-closed). LLM conversation interface via POST /messages.
rows.notRequiredReason: SYSREQ-001 LLM interface implemented as messages.controller.ts + llm.service.ts stub; no additional dedicated endpoint.

rows.title: Incremental business model construction engine
rows.evidence: SYSREQ-002 implemented in business-model.service.ts: incremental concept extraction on sendMessage; served by UC-003 endpoints.
rows.notRequiredReason: SYSREQ-002 is the business-logic layer behind UC-003 endpoints; no additional dedicated endpoint.

rows.title: Business pattern matching against configured pattern library
rows.evidence: SYSREQ-003 implemented in patterns.service.ts; pattern library CRUD served by UC-007 endpoints. INT-002 Config Service stub.
rows.notRequiredReason: SYSREQ-003 is the pattern matching engine behind UC-007 and POST /messages; no additional dedicated endpoint.

rows.title: Solution hypothesis generation and versioned management
rows.evidence: SYSREQ-004 implemented in hypotheses.service.ts; served by UC-004 endpoints (listHypotheses, getHypothesis, updateHypothesisStatus).
rows.notRequiredReason: SYSREQ-004 is the hypothesis engine behind UC-004; no additional dedicated endpoint.

rows.title: Persistent session storage with full state restoration
rows.evidence: SYSREQ-005 implemented via MongoDB persistence in sessions.service.ts + Mongoose schemas. Full state restoration served by getSession (UC-006).
rows.notRequiredReason: SYSREQ-005 is the persistence layer behind UC-001/UC-006; served by existing session endpoints.

rows.title: Specialist agent orchestration and delegation protocol
rows.evidence: SYSREQ-007 implemented as specialists.service.ts orchestration layer; UC-005 endpoints serve the delegation protocol. INT-003..006 stubs fail-closed.
rows.notRequiredReason: SYSREQ-007 is the orchestration layer behind UC-005; served by existing specialist endpoints.

rows.title: Anthropic Claude API integration with resilient error handling
rows.evidence: SYSREQ-008 implemented in llm.service.ts with retry (3x, exponential backoff) and circuit breaker. Stub/fail-closed per INT-001 pending OPEN-001/002/006.
rows.notRequiredReason: SYSREQ-008 is the LLM API integration layer in llm.service.ts; no dedicated REST endpoint.

rows.title: WCAG 2.1 Level AA accessible GoA Design System UI
rows.evidence: SYSREQ-014 is a UI accessibility requirement deferred to Stage 5. planner-service is a REST API; WCAG compliance belongs to the React frontend (apps/planner-app).
rows.notRequiredReason: Stage 5 scope: UI accessibility requirements implemented in client interface build (apps/planner-app), not in planner-service REST API.

rows.title: Anthropic SDK integration with conversation context management
rows.evidence: SWREQ-001 implemented in llm.service.ts (Anthropic SDK wrapper stub). Conversation context in messages.service.ts via ConversationMessage entity. INT-001 stub/fail-closed.
rows.notRequiredReason: SWREQ-001 is the LLM SDK integration layer in llm.service.ts; no dedicated REST endpoint.

rows.title: Planning session REST API controller
rows.evidence: SWREQ-002 implemented as sessions.controller.ts (5 endpoints: createSession, listSessions, getSession, updateSession, archiveSession). Serves UC-001, UC-006, SYSREQ-022.
rows.notRequiredReason: SWREQ-002 is the sessions controller itself; covered by UC-001 and UC-006 mapped rows.

rows.title: BusinessModel Mongoose schema and tenant-scoped repository
rows.evidence: SWREQ-003 implemented as business-model.schema.ts (Mongoose schema) + business-model.service.ts (tenant-scoped repository). All queries include tenantId per BR-001.
rows.notRequiredReason: SWREQ-003 is the data access layer behind UC-003 endpoints; no additional dedicated endpoint.

rows.title: Pattern matching service with composite confidence scoring
rows.evidence: SWREQ-004 implemented in patterns.service.ts with pattern matching engine and confidence scoring triggered by sendMessage response. INT-002 stub.
rows.notRequiredReason: SWREQ-004 is the pattern matching engine behind UC-007; served by existing pattern endpoints.

rows.title: SolutionHypothesis generation service triggered by confidence threshold
rows.evidence: SWREQ-005 implemented in hypotheses.service.ts: hypothesis generation triggered when pattern confidence exceeds threshold; BR-010 status lifecycle.
rows.notRequiredReason: SWREQ-005 is the hypothesis generation engine behind UC-004; served by existing hypothesis endpoints.

rows.title: Domain event publication service wrapping RabbitMQ
rows.evidence: SWREQ-009 implemented in event.service.ts: EventPublicationService wraps INT-007 RabbitMQ stub. Domain events logged but not transmitted until INT-007 live.
rows.notRequiredReason: SWREQ-009 is the event service layer; deferred to INT-007 stub. No dedicated REST endpoint.

rows.title: React planner workspace UI components using GoA Design System 2.0
rows.evidence: SWREQ-010 is a UI component requirement deferred to Stage 5. React UI components implemented in apps/planner-app, not in planner-service REST API.
rows.notRequiredReason: Stage 5 scope: React UI components are in the client interface build (apps/planner-app).

rows.title: LLMCallWrapper with retry and circuit breaker
rows.evidence: SWREQ-015 implemented in llm.service.ts: LLMCallWrapper with 3 retries (1-16s exponential), circuit breaker (open after 3 failures/30s, close after 60s). INT-001 stub pending OPEN-001/002/006.
rows.notRequiredReason: SWREQ-015 is the LLM resilience wrapper in llm.service.ts; no dedicated REST endpoint.

rows.title: User identity context endpoint for planner-service JWT claims
rows.evidence: GET /api/v1/users/me returns the authenticated user profile (userId, tenantId, roles, email, displayName) extracted from the Keycloak JWT via INT-008. Satisfies sitemap user-management page API requirement (FAC-S4-014). Protected B fields returned to authenticated user only; email/displayName never logged.
